2020/12/12 Prototype version.

Part 1: Basic Hero

Hero is a scion class that uses Sword, TMG, and Talis. They have a huge damage boost as long as you can avoid losing 20% of you max HP in 5 second.

@<&nbsp;>@ This guide assumes that:

  • You know how PSO2 works in general, as you need 2 level 75 classes to unlock Hero
  • You have done the Hero Tutorial
  • You know who Stratos (ストラトス) is
  • You can amass Excubes
  • You can amass Photon Spheres

Hero Mag

Thanks to Hero Mag skill, any points added to a mag's S-ATK, R-ATK, and T-ATK will be distributed to all attacks at 1:1 rate. So if you have 200 T-ATK mag, you'll also gain 200 S-ATK and 200 R-ATK.

Preferably your mag has this following setup:

Parameter Value Description
T-ATK 200 Focusing on pure T-ATK will give you access to the exclusive, PP Restore J.
Photon Blast Cetus Proi You'll automatically get Cetus Proi upon focusing on T-ATK. You can buy PB Device Cetus P (PBデバイス／ケートスP) from the Excube shop.
Auto Action Megid Megid is a powerful auto action and can poison enemy. Along with Talis and Mag Excite Ring, your mag can contribute damage comparable to S4 Raising Pursuit. You can buy [[span class="icon item-devc"]]T-ATK Device Megid (法撃デバイス／メギド) from the Excube Shop[[/span]]
Auto SP Action Barricade (鉄壁 Unbreakable) I personally prefer this since in higher difficulty bosses can do a lot of damage in a single bow; this can be a lifesaver when you least expect it. You can buy [[span class="icon item-devc"]]SP DEX Device Barricade (SP技量デバイス／鉄壁 SP DEX Device Iron Wall) from the Excube Shop.[[/span]] If you have PP trouble, pick Rapid Fire. Dance is hardly useful because it's hard to time it properly with your burst attacks.

Skill Tree

Hero's skill tree doesn't require too much details. For general purpose, you can just use Recommended Setting, but it will skip putting points on those stat boosters. Generally take everything except the optional skills, listed below.

For a Skill Simulator version, click here @<&nbsp;>@

About Hero Boost and Hero Counter

Hero Boost gives 80% damage increase, but if you lose 20% of your max HP in 5 seconds (regardless of current HP), you also lose 20% damage, bringing you down to 60%. Hero Boost will build this back by 1% per second, or you can do 1 Hero Counter to bring it back to 80%.

[[div_ class="manaka-text-box-container"]] [[div_ class="manaka-text-box"]] Caution! Hero Step is not as good as Phantom, Etoile, or Luster step: you can still get hit after the "Shing!" sound effect if your response is slow (like me).

Part 2: Intermediate Hero

@<&nbsp;>@ Intermediate Objectives:

  • You can assign helpful rings on your units: Atomizer Lovers and Party of Toughness
  • You know the quirks of each Hero Weapon
  • You can perform the optimum rotation combo of Sword
  • You can perform the optimum rotation combo of Talis

[[image img%3Apso2-ui/ui-wp-sw.png class="h2-icon"]] Sword

To know the basics of Sword, please do the Hero Training Quest on Sword. Sword is the easiest weapon to use and used to be the only Hero weapon, delegating the other two to just utility. Now, it's still the most balanced weapon and safest to use. If you want to start using Hero, start with Sword.

Strength Weakness
Easy to use.Deadly from middle range.Main DPS combo has both invulnerability frames and guard frames.Has a charge ability to do huge damage while waiting for boss. PP consumption is exceedingly high.Have little means to regain PP.Counterattacking forces you to land.

[[image img%3Apso2-ui/ui-wp-tm.png class="h2-icon"]] TMG

To know the basics of TMG, please do the Hero Training Quest on TMG. TMG reward aggressive play with its powerful counterattack, while keeping the safe side by staying at mid-range.

Strength Weakness
High aerial capabilityAble to refill PP quickly.Main DPS has invulnerability frames.Has no need for combo to do maximum damage.Strongest normal attack.Stongest counter. Subject to range penalty, attacking from too far will result in reduced damage.Have to attack that fills PP.Single-hit Hero Time Finisher often subjected to damage cap.

[[image img%3Apso2-ui/ui-wp-ta.png class="h2-icon"]] Talis

To know the basics of Talis, please do the Hero Training Quest on Talis. Talis hits hard and is relatively lenient on it's PP consumption. It builds the Hero focus fastest, and also have the strongest Hero Time Finish.

Strength Weakness
High aerial capabilityCasting Techs mid-air causes you to float, allowing you to keep your aerial combat height.Can warp to high altitude easily, creating instant vantage point.Combos can be reset easily with warping.Hero Focus/Gear fills quickest. Main DPS is neither agile nor has protective frames.Weakest normal attack.Hero Time Finisher is powerful but takes long to do full-damage.

Part 3: Advanced Hero

@<&nbsp;>@ Advanced Objectives:

  • You can create a low cost but potent units
  • You can create a potent PP units
  • You know PP efficiency alternative to pure damage

Units

For damage purpose, Hero uses corresponding attack based on the equipped weapon. For easier time, put some HP on your units. For further information on units, please take a look on the companion guide, linked below!

[[ul class="nav nav-pills series-nav nav-justified" role="tablist"]] [[li class=""]][[image ./img%3Apso2-ui/ui-unit-rear.png class="pso2-nav-icon"]] Units[[/li]] [[/ul]]

Weapons

As with units, use whatever's available. The weapons listed below are more less, commonly used and/or easy to obtain. If you struggle to obtain a ★15, Atra Ex and Austere can be made easily.

[[div_ class="manaka-text-box-container"]] [[div_ class="manaka-text-box"]] Reminder to transfer your S-Class Abilities, not use the weapon as fodder!

[[div_ class="text-center manaka-icon-container"]]

Icon Name S-Slot Description
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-cras.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-cras.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tl-cras.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Cras @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ Similar to Ayer with 30s damage boost mode and higher stat.Requires a Graeae, currently very limited in circulationActivating damage boost mode requires doing 3 normal attacks in a row, step attack doesn’t count.Activating damage boost mode removes the PP cut and persistent PP regenration.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-ayer.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-ayer.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tl-ayer.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Ayer @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ Provides persistent PP regeneration and PP cut.By putting Petalgleam / Red Petal Flash and S4 Rainbow Balance, this weapon lowers your PP cost a lot.As strong as fully-boosted Stil.Easy to purchase from Zieg.Unless you get it as drop, you will need Grind Caps to increase the cap; fortunatel Grind Caps becomes an easy drop later on.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-stil.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-stil.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tl-stil.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Stil @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ Very powerful with persistent PP regeneration, as long as you can avoid getting hit.S5 is most useful for TMG.Requires a lot of material to the point of insanity.Requires Liberate to get the desired DB and Wand S5.Getting hit a lot will lower the overall damage you do.Rivalate Sword S5 does not work on Hr.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-soldam.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-soldam.png class="pso2-icon double"]] (Sodam) @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ This is the weapon drop from Ultimate Quest Sodam and only useful if you don't have anything else and is prone to mistakes.All weapons have different names, but has same potential that allows you to use mate items instantly.You'll never need to use mate items instantly as you're actively tring to avoid damage.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-adel.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-adel.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tl-adel.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Adel @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ A great Hr-exclusive weapon that is easy to obtain.This weapon slows down Hero Time focus drain when equpped, regardless of what weapon you activate with; allowing you to extend Hero Time on-demand, especially when boss suddenly go through a phase change.Also doubles the maximum number of Hero Time Counter focus gain during Hero time from 8 to 16.Permanently available via Collection File, and collection File provides Grind Caps.Overall weaker than Ayer.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-ponzu.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Bonds @<&nbsp;>@ Grants 600 more ATK when Shifta is active.Available from Divide Medal ExhangeBarely drops, and the price at the Medal Exchange is steep.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-chaval.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Chaval @<&nbsp;>@ Powerful on its own, but requires a curve to understand it's gimmick.Inadequate S-Augments.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-liberate.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-liberate.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tl-liberate.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Liberate @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ Huge PP cut with increased critical rate.S4 can be used to put persistent PP regeneration like Colossal Radiance.S5 is most useful for TMG.Requires Liberate Unlocker, which at first, is a feat to obtain.Rivalate Sword S5 does not work on Hr.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-atraex.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-atraex.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tl-atraex.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Atlas Ex @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ Prevents death once, if you're prone to making mistake.Can obtain at least 2 copies easily.Very straightforward potential.S4 can be used to put persistent PP regeneration like Colossal Radiance.None.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-lightstream.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-lightstream.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tl-lightstream.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Xion @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ Solid stat with PP-refilling effect, can never go wrong with it.Requires Amphitrite Stone, which is also a feat to obtain.More less just a PP-battery, useful if you have a huge amount of PP.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-austere.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-austere.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tl-austere.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Austere @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ Surprisingly strong by using it's Nemesis Potential (Darkness Shield), as long as you don't get hit a lot.All weapon ingredients can be brought.Weak if you get hit a lot, at least until you can change to it's Redux potential.
[[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-sw-dyne.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tm-dyne.png class="pso2-icon double"]][[image ./img%3Apso2-wp/wp-tl-dyne.png class="pso2-icon double"]] Dyne @<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@@<&nbsp;>@ The power boost and damage reduction activates even if you lost 1 HP.You can keep the power boost and damage reduction indefinitely by deliberately augmenting one weapon with higher HP; use the lower HP agument weapon and then swap to the higher HP weapon until the potential kicks in.Power is just average.

Weapon Affix

I personally go for a 6 to 7 slot easy-to-achieve affix. Adding damage like S1:Augment Intent is a common option, but I prefer increased PP efficiency, especially since Wand requires it.
